input_fields.name: actual_model
input_fields.description: One active model identity already approved for export.

input_fields.name: output_format_path
input_fields.description: Requested supported export format and one run-owned output path.

input_fields.name: options
input_fields.description: Explicit export options for this one request.

result_fields.name: export_result
result_fields.description: One export command/result, model identity, requested format/path, and observed file identity when available.

procedure: Verify active model, supported format, options, and run-owned path.
Issue one visible export command and record the resulting dialog/status/file identity.
Return export_result and export_status; preserve unknown completion as needs_manual_review.
Do not reimport the export or inspect a second format.
rejection_rules: Reject unsupported format, ambiguous model/path, missing user request, or unsafe overwrite.
Do not repeat an uncertain export command.
Do not claim exported geometry retention from file existence alone.
